title: HelperFSWriteOpenParams
description: Params of the helper fs service's write-open op. The id is the caller's 128-bit session identity, spelled as 32 lower-case hex characters: it travels back on every chunk, the commit and the abort, and it is also the temporary file's name, so the alphabet is the guarantee that a session cannot name a path. The path is the target as the caller knows it; the helper resolves every symlink on it ONCE and answers where the bytes will land.

id.description: The caller's 128-bit session identifier, lower-case hex only. Any other spelling is refused `bad-session`.

path.description: The absolute path to write. The final component may not exist yet — the directory it would be created in must. A symlink, including a final component that is one, is followed so the write lands where the link points; the link survives. A dangling link, a directory, a FIFO, a device or a socket is refused `not-regular`.
